none.name: None
none.description: No filter applied. The image stays as you corrected it.

natural.name: Natural
natural.description: A barely noticeable touch-up, with slightly more vivid colors and soft contrast.

deepSky.name: Deep-sky
deepSky.description: Darkens the sky background and makes nebula colors stronger. It is the most widely used treatment in astrophotography.

blazingNebula.name: Blazing nebula
blazingNebula.description: Brings out the hydrogen reds, the most common color in nebulae that emit their own light.

polarChill.name: Polar chill
polarChill.description: A cool cast over the whole image, with shadows leaning toward blue.

aquamarine.name: Aquamarine
aquamarine.description: Tones the sky toward aqua green. Works well on planetary nebulae.

amethyst.name: Amethyst
amethyst.description: Violet reflections in the highlights, blue in the shadows.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: Northern-lights green in the midtones and a hint of magenta in the highlights.

cosmicSunset.name: Cosmic sunset
cosmicSunset.description: Plum shadows and golden highlights, for a warm atmosphere.

cinematic.name: Cinematic
cinematic.description: Teal shadows and orange highlights, the color contrast typical of cinema.

antiqueGold.name: Antique gold
antiqueGold.description: An even golden toning, with most of the colors muted.

copper.name: Copper
copper.description: A warm metallic tone, with deep shadows.

blueNight.name: Blue night
blueNight.description: Iron toning like old prints, which pushes the whole image toward blue.

ice.name: Ice
ice.description: Very bright highlights with a slight blue tint, clean shadows.

pastel.name: Pastel
pastel.description: Soft colors and reduced contrast, for a delicate result.

dreamy.name: Dreamy
dreamy.description: Reduced contrast, soft highlights and slightly violet shadows.

dramatic.name: Dramatic
dramatic.description: Strong contrast and darkened image edges, which draw attention to the subject.

vintage.name: Vintage
vintage.description: Muted colors and warm shadows, like an old slide.

diamondStars.name: Diamond stars
diamondStars.description: Brilliant highlights and a compact background, which make stars stand out as points of light.

milkyWay.name: Milky Way
milkyWay.description: Warm tones on rich star fields, without dulling the blue of young stars.

falseColor.name: False color
falseColor.description: Clearly separates the color channels, with a bold effect similar to narrowband imaging, which uses filters that let through only one color of light.

silver.name: Silver
silver.description: Neutral black and white, from deep black to clean white.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.description: Moody black and white, with closed shadows and contained highlights.

sepia.name: Sepia
sepia.description: Sepia toning, the warm brown tone of nineteenth-century photography.

graphite.name: Graphite
graphite.description: Cool monochrome with a slight blue cast.
